description_zh: 更新自定义转码模板设置
name: UpdateTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the template. The name can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213306.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The container format. The value is a JSON object. Default format: MP4.

Video formats: FLV, MP4, HLS (M3U8 + TS), and MPEG-DASH (MPD + fMP4)
Audio formats: MP3, MP4, OGG, FLAC, and M4A
Images formats: GIF and WebP

For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html parameter of the "Parameter details" topic
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。最大长度128字节
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the video stream. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html parameter of the "Parameter details" topic
parameters.help_zh:
容器，JSON对象。默认值：mp4

视频转码支持flv、mp4、HLS（m3u8+ts）、MPEG-DASH（MPD+fMP4）。

音频转码支持mp3、mp4、ogg、flac、m4a。

图片支持gif、WEBP。

更多信息请参见参数详情https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: container

parameters.help_en: The configurations of the audio stream. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html parameter of the "Parameter details" topic
parameters.help_zh: 视频流配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: video

parameters.help_en: The transmuxing configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html parameter of the "Parameter details" topic
parameters.help_zh: 音频流配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: audio

parameters.help_en: The general transcoding configurations. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html parameter of the "Parameter details" topic
parameters.help_zh: 封包配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: mux_config

parameters.help_zh: 转码通用配置，JSON对象。更多信息请参见参数详情https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: trans_config
